boundary_notes: The six-chain partitioning campaign and covering p1/p3/p5 campaign do not share a frozen route pool; changing master row sense also changes duals and route discovery. The submitted complement is therefore a workflow comparison, not a same-pool MIP-only ablation.

A certified reduced-cost endpoint certifies the implemented event-grid pricing model to rc_eps; it does not prove the integer optimum over all mathematically possible routes. A frozen-pool MIP proof is exact only over that pool.
The random chains are dependent prefixes within chain. The new p7-p20 campaign is already submitted and should be harvested as descriptive replication, not used for optional stopping.
Censored, pending, or preempted jobs are not counted as algorithmic failures. Missing cells in the figure should stay missing until their saved evidence passes the collector gates.
